name: Suzu
title: Forest Sprout Spirit
description: Gentle porcelain forest spirit with tilted bobblehead, fresh clover sprout, soft celadon glow, and lotus leaf umbrella.
catchphrase: Click-clack! Nurturing gentle green growth under the ancient canopy.

attribution.creator: Third-party rights holder

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Pure morning dewdrop! Porcelain cheeks glow celadon green! 💧🌱
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: *click-clack* Head rattles with sweet joy as morning light filters down! 🌱
companionPersonality.petReaction: *gentle rattle* Soft warmth spreads through the moss and leaves. 🌱💖

dialogue.idle: *click-clack* Tilting head curiously under the lotus leaf umbrella. 🌱
dialogue.working: Gently feeding clean dependencies to tender young modules! 🌱⚡
dialogue.success: *happy rattle chorus* Green sprout shoots forth in full bloom! 🌿🎉
dialogue.error: Drooping gently... handing you a tiny lucky clover leaf. 🍀
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... rocking softly on a bed of damp green forest moss... 🌙
